messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: dedicated-reserved-pool alert for AsterBank (tenant_id: ab-900). Metric: reserved_pool_queue_delay > 10s for 4m. PD: https://pd.example/INC-9931
PagerDuty: Incident INC-9931 created (severity P1). Notifying oncall: mara-oncall. Escalation: oncall -> sre-lead.
mara-oncall: Ack. Taking ownership. Any customer errors observed?
jonas (sre): seeing p95 jump from ~80ms -> 2.1s and 504/503s increasing. QPS steady. Worker queues full, many requests hitting reserved queue timeout. KV cache churn high.
lei: kvcache: miss_rate=0.47 evictions=2301 over 5m. One replica (ab-node-07) showing repeated gpu driver resets at 14:07:03 UTC.
eng-runtime: Their reserved pool is at 94% occupancy and autoscale is capped by tenant quota. Fallback routing exists but control-plane lookup for model alias timed out twice.
mara-oncall: Plan: 1) Post customer notice via AsterSupport 2) enable temporary shared-burst (allow borrowing) for 15m 3) divert 40% to fallback model redwood-4b-quant-fallback 4) recycle suspect node ab-node-07 5) submit infra scale request to add 1 worker. Approve these items?
aster-support: (automated) Notifying AsterBank on-call: "We're investigating elevated latency on your reserved inference pool. We'll provide updates every 10 minutes."
jonas (sre): running quick health check:
```
curl -s -I "https://inference.api.redwood/v1/tenants/ab-900/generate" -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -w '%{http_code} %{time_total}\n' -o /dev/null
```
results: 504 2.03s, 503 1.9s (5/10).
lei: kernel logs from ab-node-07 show 'NVRM: GPU has fallen off the bus' repeats. Looks like a hardware/driver fault.
eng-runtime: I can flip burst + routing and queue a node recycle if approved. Also can open immediate fallback mapping to avoid control-plane timeouts.
mara-oncall: do it. Enable shared-burst 15m, route 40% -> redwood-4b-quant-fallback, recycle ab-node-07 now, queue scale add 1. Keep me posted.
eng-runtime: applied changes: shared-burst=15m, traffic_split: 40% -> redwood-4b-quant-fallback. Recycle job started for ab-node-07 (job_id=recycle-331).
jonas (sre): scale request: `infra scale-reserved --tenant ab-900 --add 1` -> queued job_id=scale-9122, est 90s.
aster-support: (automated) Sent update to AsterBank: "We've enabled temporary shared burst, routed part of traffic to a fallback model, and are recycling a suspect host. Monitoring now."
mara-oncall: monitoring dashboards. Can someone watch p99 and error rate? I'll update PD.
jonas (sre): 2m after changes: p95 down to 220ms, p99 720ms, errors 1.1% (was 6%). Good but not fully stable.
sre-lead: good. Keep costs in mind but prioritize stability. Document all steps.
lei: ab-node-07 recycle completed, node offlined then returned. Post-recycle logs show no further driver resets. KV miss rate improving (0.31).
eng-runtime: scale job completed, +1 worker online. Temp burst still active for 12m. Routing stable.
mara-oncall: PD update: "Mitigated: temporary shared-burst + 40% traffic to fallback model + recycled problematic host + scaled reserved pool by +1. Latency and error rates improved significantly. Monitoring for 30m. Suspected root cause: intermittent GPU driver/hardware failure causing replica flapping and queue saturation. Follow-ups: replace ab-node-07 if flaps again, increase autoscale headroom for tenant, make model-alias lookup resilient to control-plane delays."
aster-support: (automated) Customer update delivered: "Services recovering. We will send a full incident report after internal review."
jonas (sre): filing follow-up ticket: infra#5902 "ab-900 dedicated host health + driver audit" assigned to eng-runtime.
eng-runtime: ack. We'll run driver/firmware audit across the pool and add a short-circuit in alias resolution so fallback mapping uses cached alias when control-plane is slow.
mara-oncall: preparing handoff to @ops-night. Leaving PD acknowledged. I'll capture timeline and notes in incident doc.
sre-lead: Thanks team. Add cost estimate for burst to the incident note.
mara-oncall: Timeline for incident window: 14:06:50 UTC -> 14:15:30 UTC. Follow-ups: host replacement, autoscale policy tweak, alias-caching guard, postmortem.
PagerDuty: INC-9931 annotated -> acknowledged -> pending. Link: https://pd.example/INC-9931
IncidentBot: Note: auto-escalation will trigger if similar alert returns within 10m.
ops-night: (handed over) Acknowledged. I'll watch the dashboards for the next 2h and escalate if regresses.
mara-oncall: signing off from live. I'll draft the postmortem and share with SRE. :white_check_mark:
